  Location: apply_silver_rules function, line 29

  Location: filter_recent_transactions function, line 16
  Problem: The comparison uses >= instead of >, which includes the cutoff date in the results, violating the business rule.
  Fix: Change `txn_date >= cutoff` to `txn_date > cutoff`.
